preconditions.description: n is the number of vertices (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), m is the number of edges with weight 1 (0 ≤ m ≤ min(n(n-1)/2, 10^5)).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n and a_i != b_i for a_i, b_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (a_i, b_i) has distinct endpoints within the vertex range [1, n].
The input contains exactly m edges with weight 1.

preconditions.expression: all(a_i != b_j or b_i != a_j or a_i != a_j or b_i != b_j for i in range(m) for j in range(i+1, m))
preconditions.description: No edge appears twice in the input (all edges are unique).

postconditions.description: The output is the weight of the minimum spanning tree (MST). If m ≥ n-1, the MST weight is m - (n - 1) (since the MST must include exactly n-1 edges, and the remaining edges are weight 0). Otherwise, the MST weight is 0 (all edges are weight 0).
